# Evidence Record: <claim>

- Claim: `<statement this evidence supports or rejects>`
- Observation: `<direct observation>`
- Artifact identity: `<revision, digest, data-set version, or n/a with reason>`
- Environment identity: `<environment, configuration, or n/a with reason>`
- Method: `<command, measurement, inspection, or review method>`
- Result: `<terminal result>`
- Citation: `<log lines, file, artifact, source, or URL>`
- Captured at: `<timestamp or event coordinate>`
- Freshness or supersession: `<event that invalidates this evidence>`
- Inference, if any: `<clearly labeled conclusion>`

Never include a secret value. Record only an approved opaque reference and
non-secret observation when the claim involves a secret.
